# Documentation generated by QDoc from the comments in the launcher's own
# sources, and from there into Markdown for the Astro site.
#
#   cmake --build <build> --target docs           # DocBook XML
#   cmake --build <build> --target docs-markdown   # Markdown for the site
#   cmake --build <build> --target docs-html       # HTML, for reading locally
#
# Everything QDoc needs to know about the code -- which files carry the
# comments, which include paths clang needs, what version this is -- is taken
# from the MeshMC_logic target rather than repeated in a configuration file,
# because a hand-kept copy of that list stops matching the build without
# saying so.

# -- qdoc --------------------------------------------------------------------

# /usr/bin/qdoc is Qt 5's on several distributions (Fedora among them) and
# cannot read Qt 6's configuration, so the versioned name is tried first and
# whatever is found is checked before it is used.
find_program(MeshMC_QDOC_EXECUTABLE
    NAMES qdoc-qt${QT_VERSION_MAJOR} qdoc
    HINTS "${QT${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${QT${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}_INSTALL_BINS}"
          "${QT${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${QT${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}_INSTALL_LIBEXECS}"
    DOC "QDoc, the documentation generator that ships with Qt"
)

if(NOT MeshMC_QDOC_EXECUTABLE)
    message(STATUS "QDoc not found; the documentation targets are unavailable")
    return()
endif()

execute_process(
    COMMAND "${MeshMC_QDOC_EXECUTABLE}" --version
    OUTPUT_VARIABLE _qdoc_version_output
    ERROR_VARIABLE _qdoc_version_output
    OUTPUT_STRIP_TRAILING_WHITESPACE
)
string(REGEX MATCH "([0-9]+)\\.([0-9]+)\\.([0-9]+)" _qdoc_version "${_qdoc_version_output}")

if(NOT _qdoc_version)
    message(STATUS "Could not read a version out of ${MeshMC_QDOC_EXECUTABLE} "
                   "(\"${_qdoc_version_output}\"); the documentation targets "
                   "are unavailable")
    return()
elseif(NOT CMAKE_MATCH_1 STREQUAL QT_VERSION_MAJOR)
    message(STATUS "${MeshMC_QDOC_EXECUTABLE} is QDoc ${_qdoc_version}, but the "
                   "launcher is built against Qt ${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}; the "
                   "documentation targets are unavailable. Set "
                   "MeshMC_QDOC_EXECUTABLE to the matching qdoc.")
    return()
endif()

set(MeshMC_DOCS_QT_VERSION "${_qdoc_version}")
set(MeshMC_DOCS_QT_VER "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}.${CMAKE_MATCH_2}")
set(MeshMC_DOCS_QT_VERSION_TAG "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}${CMAKE_MATCH_2}${CMAKE_MATCH_3}")

# Qt's documentation configuration, which the generated .qdocconf includes.
# QT<n>_INSTALL_DOCS is relative to the install prefix when Qt sets it.
if(DEFINED QT${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}_INSTALL_DOCS)
    if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${QT${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}_INSTALL_DOCS}")
        set(MeshMC_DOCS_QT_INSTALL_DOCS "${QT${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}_INSTALL_DOCS}")
    else()
        set(MeshMC_DOCS_QT_INSTALL_DOCS
            "${QT${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}_INSTALL_PREFIX}/${QT${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}_INSTALL_DOCS}")
    endif()
endif()

if(NOT EXISTS "${MeshMC_DOCS_QT_INSTALL_DOCS}/global/qt-module-defaults.qdocconf")
    message(STATUS "Qt's documentation configuration was not found under "
                   "\"${MeshMC_DOCS_QT_INSTALL_DOCS}/global\" -- install the Qt "
                   "${QT_VERSION_MAJOR} documentation package (qt${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}-doc, "
                   "qt${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}-base-doc or similar). The documentation "
                   "targets are unavailable.")
    return()
endif()

# -- what to document --------------------------------------------------------

# Every target that carries launcher code, not just the library: main.cpp
# belongs to the application target, so a list taken from MeshMC_logic alone
# leaves out the entry point -- which was the first thing anyone tried to
# document. The updater is a second executable and is included when it is
# built at all (it is not, on macOS).
set(MeshMC_DOCS_TARGETS MeshMC_logic ${MeshMC_Name})
if(TARGET meshmc_updater_logic)
    list(APPEND MeshMC_DOCS_TARGETS meshmc_updater_logic)
endif()

# Read at configure time rather than through a generator expression, because
# the value is written into a configuration file; .ui and .qrc entries would
# only make clang complain.
set(MeshMC_DOCS_SOURCE_LIST "")
foreach(_target IN LISTS MeshMC_DOCS_TARGETS)
    if(NOT TARGET ${_target})
        continue()
    endif()
    get_target_property(_target_sources ${_target} SOURCES)
    get_target_property(_target_source_dir ${_target} SOURCE_DIR)
    foreach(_source IN LISTS _target_sources)
        if(NOT _source MATCHES "\\.(cpp|cc|cxx|mm|h|hpp)$")
            continue()
        endif()
        # Generated sources (moc, ui headers) describe nothing a reader wants.
        if(_source MATCHES "(^|/)(moc_|ui_|qrc_)")
            continue()
        endif()
        if(IS_ABSOLUTE "${_source}")
            set(_absolute "${_source}")
        else()
            set(_absolute "${_target_source_dir}/${_source}")
        endif()
        # Anything under the build tree is generated; skip it.
        if(_absolute MATCHES "^${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}")
            continue()
        endif()
        list(APPEND MeshMC_DOCS_SOURCE_LIST "${_absolute}")
    endforeach()
endforeach()

list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES MeshMC_DOCS_SOURCE_LIST)
list(LENGTH MeshMC_DOCS_SOURCE_LIST _source_count)

# QDoc's configuration format takes a backslash-continued list.
string(REPLACE ";" " \\\n          " MeshMC_DOCS_SOURCES "${MeshMC_DOCS_SOURCE_LIST}")

# -- where to look for headers -----------------------------------------------

get_target_property(_logic_includes MeshMC_logic INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)

# The application target adds nothing of its own, so one target's include
# directories cover all of them.

set(_include_flags "")
foreach(_dir IN LISTS _logic_includes)
    # Generator expressions cannot be resolved at configure time; a build
    # interface path is the common case and is taken as-is.
    if(_dir MATCHES "^\\$<BUILD_INTERFACE:(.*)>$")
        set(_dir "${CMAKE_MATCH_1}")
    elseif(_dir MATCHES "\\$<")
        continue()
    endif()
    if(IS_DIRECTORY "${_dir}")
        list(APPEND _include_flags "-I${_dir}")
    endif()
endforeach()

# The Qt modules the launcher is built against. Taken from the imported
# targets so that this does not have to name Qt's directory layout.
foreach(_component IN LISTS MeshMC_QT_COMPONENTS)
    if(NOT TARGET Qt${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}::${_component})
        continue()
    endif()
    get_target_property(_qt_includes Qt${QT_VERSION_MAJOR}::${_component}
                        INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES)
    foreach(_dir IN LISTS _qt_includes)
        if(_dir MATCHES "\\$<" OR NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${_dir}")
            continue()
        endif()
        list(APPEND _include_flags "-I${_dir}")
    endforeach()
endforeach()

list(REMOVE_DUPLICATES _include_flags)
string(REPLACE ";" " \\\n                " MeshMC_DOCS_INCLUDEPATHS "${_include_flags}")

# -- targets -----------------------------------------------------------------

set(MeshMC_DOCS_OUTPUT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/docbook")
configure_file(qdoc/meshmc.qdocconf.in "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/meshmc.qdocconf" @ONLY)

# HTML and DocBook differ only in the generator, so one configuration serves
# both and the format is chosen on the command line.
set(_qdoc_command
    "${MeshMC_QDOC_EXECUTABLE}" "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/meshmc.qdocconf"
    --indexdir "${MeshMC_DOCS_QT_INSTALL_DOCS}"
)

add_custom_target(docs
    # QDoc refuses to write into a directory that has unrelated content in it,
    # so a rerun starts from an empty one.
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E rm -rf "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/docbook"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/docbook"
    COMMAND ${_qdoc_command} --outputformat DocBook
            --outputdir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/docbook"
    COMMENT "Generating DocBook documentation from ${_source_count} source file(s)"
    VERBATIM
)

add_custom_target(docs-html
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E rm -rf "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/html"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/html"
    COMMAND ${_qdoc_command} --outputformat HTML
            --outputdir "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/html"
    COMMENT "Generating HTML documentation for local reading"
    VERBATIM
)

find_package(Python3 QUIET COMPONENTS Interpreter)

if(Python3_Interpreter_FOUND)
    # Where the Markdown lands. Point this at the site's content directory to
    # publish straight into it, for example:
    #   -D MeshMC_DOCS_MARKDOWN_DIR=../PrismLauncher.org/src/content/docs/api
    set(MeshMC_DOCS_MARKDOWN_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/markdown"
        CACHE PATH "Directory the generated Markdown is written to")

    add_custom_target(docs-markdown
        COMMAND "${Python3_EXECUTABLE}"
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/qdoc/docbook-to-starlight.py"
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/docbook"
                "${MeshMC_DOCS_MARKDOWN_DIR}"
        DEPENDS docs
        COMMENT "Converting DocBook to Markdown in ${MeshMC_DOCS_MARKDOWN_DIR}"
        VERBATIM
    )
else()
    message(STATUS "Python 3 not found; the docs-markdown target is unavailable")
endif()

message(STATUS "QDoc: ${MeshMC_QDOC_EXECUTABLE} (${_qdoc_version}), "
               "${_source_count} documented source file(s)")
